diagnosis.cause: The Responses endpoint returned an SSE body without Content-Type; the parser rejected it before reading any events.
diagnosis.diagnostics: A temporary diagnostic recorded only status, body availability and Content-Type. It was removed from the final deployment.

fix.absentContentType: Parse bounded SSE and require response.completed.
fix.explicitContentType: Normalize case and media-type parameters, require text/event-stream, and cancel rejected bodies.
fix.admissionGuard: HTTP 200, JSON replies, partial text, failed/incomplete events, and streams without response.completed cannot pass.

regressions.before: Missing and case-varied SSE media types failed with CHATGPT_INVALID_STREAM.
regressions.after: Valid SSE succeeds; missing-header JSON and truncated streams fail; explicitly unsupported types fail and cancel their bodies.

liveBrowser.mode: Built browser with actual next account and probe API responses through private verification RPC

remaining: Agent LanguageModel adapter, model selection, resumable quota handling, full tool/recovery acceptance and separate production admission.
